landingPatterns.name: Hero + Features + CTA
landingPatterns.keywords: hero, hero-centric, hero-centric design, features, feature-rich, feature-rich showcase, cta, call-to-action
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero with headline/image > Value prop > Key features (3-5) > CTA section > Footer
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + Bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Hero: Brand primary or vibrant. Features: Card bg #FAFAFA. CTA: Contrasting accent color
landingPatterns.effects: Hero parallax, feature card hover lift, CTA glow on hover
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast. Keep focus and component boundaries independently visible. Disable hero parallax under reduced motion and render its static final state.

landingPatterns.name: Hero + Testimonials + CTA
landingPatterns.keywords: hero, testimonials, social-proof, social-proof-focused, social proof focused, trust, reviews, cta, carousel accessibility, keyboard accessible carousel, pause auto rotation, reduced motion final state
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero > Problem statement > Solution overview > Testimonials carousel > CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + Post-testimonials
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Hero: Brand color. Testimonials: Light bg #F5F5F5. Quotes: Italic, muted color #666. CTA: Vibrant
landingPatterns.effects: Testimonial carousel slide animations, quote marks animations, avatar fade-in
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Social proof before CTA. Use a concise set of verified testimonials with photo, name, and role. CTA after social proof. Provide previous/next and pause controls; stop rotation on focus, hover, and reduced motion; announce slide position. Previous/next buttons and keyboard controls must expose every slide without dragging.

landingPatterns.name: Product Demo + Features
landingPatterns.keywords: demo, product-demo, features, showcase, interactive, interactive-product-demo, interactive product demo
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero > Product video/mockup (center) > Feature breakdown per section > Comparison (optional) > CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Video center + CTA right/bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Video surround: Brand color overlay. Features: Icon color #0080FF. Text: Dark #222
landingPatterns.effects: Video play button pulse, feature scroll reveals, demo interaction highlights
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion. Pause media when offscreen or hidden and keep the final product state available as static content.

landingPatterns.name: Minimal Single Column
landingPatterns.keywords: minimal, simple, direct, minimal & direct, minimal-direct, single-column, clean
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero headline > Short description > Benefit bullets (3 max) > CTA > Footer
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Center, large CTA button
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Minimalist: Brand + white #FFFFFF + accent. Verify CTA label text against its button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
landingPatterns.effects: Minimal hover effects. Smooth scroll. CTA scale on hover (subtle)
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Single CTA focus. Large typography. Lots of whitespace. No nav clutter. Mobile-first.

landingPatterns.name: Funnel (3-Step Conversion)
landingPatterns.keywords: funnel, conversion, conversion-optimized, conversion optimized, steps, wizard, onboarding
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero > Step 1 (problem) > Step 2 (solution) > Step 3 (action) > CTA progression
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Each step: mini-CTA. Final: main CTA
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Step colors: 1 (Red/Problem), 2 (Orange/Process), 3 (Green/Solution). CTA: Brand color
landingPatterns.effects: Step number animations, progress bar fill, step transitions smooth scroll
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Progressive disclosure. Show only essential info per step. Use progress indicators. Multiple CTAs.

landingPatterns.name: Comparison Table + CTA
landingPatterns.keywords: comparison, table, compare, versus, cta
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero > Problem intro > Comparison table (product vs competitors) > Pricing (optional) > CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Table: Right column. CTA: Below table
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Table: Alternating rows (white/light grey). Your product: Highlight #FFFACD (light yellow) or green. Text: Dark
landingPatterns.effects: Table row hover highlight, price toggle animations, feature checkmark animations
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Use comparison to show unique value. Highlight your product row. Include 'free trial' in pricing row.

landingPatterns.name: Lead Magnet + Form
landingPatterns.keywords: lead, form, signup, capture, email, magnet
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (benefit headline) > Lead magnet preview (ebook cover, checklist, etc) > Form (minimal fields) > CTA submit
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Form CTA: Submit button
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Lead magnet: Professional design. Form: Clean white bg. Inputs: Light border #CCCCCC. CTA: Brand color
landingPatterns.effects: Form focus state animations, input validation animations, success confirmation animation
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Ask only for information necessary to deliver the lead magnet. Preview its value and show submission progress.

landingPatterns.name: Pricing Page + CTA
landingPatterns.keywords: pricing, plans, tiers, comparison, cta
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (pricing headline) > Price comparison cards > Feature comparison table > FAQ section > Final CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Each card: CTA button. Sticky CTA in nav
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Free: Grey, Starter: Blue, Pro: Green/Gold, Enterprise: Dark. Cards: 1px border, shadow
landingPatterns.effects: Price toggle animation (monthly/yearly), card comparison highlight, FAQ accordion open/close
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Highlight the plan that matches the intended audience and show actual annual savings transparently. Use FAQs to address concerns.

landingPatterns.name: Video-First Hero
landingPatterns.keywords: video, hero, media, visual, engaging
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero with video background > Key features overlay > Benefits section > CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Overlay on video (center/bottom) + Bottom section
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Use an overlay strong enough for text contrast. Brand accent for CTA. Light text only when the measured contrast passes.
landingPatterns.effects: Video autoplay muted, parallax scroll, text fade-in on scroll
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Use video only when it demonstrates value better than static media. Add captions for accessibility. Compress video for performance. Provide captions and a visible pause control; use a static poster when reduced motion is requested. Pause video when offscreen or hidden; the reduced-motion poster must preserve the final message and CTA.

landingPatterns.name: Scroll-Triggered Storytelling
landingPatterns.keywords: storytelling, scroll, narrative, story, immersive
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Intro hook > Chapter 1 (problem) > Chapter 2 (journey) > Chapter 3 (solution) > Climax CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: End of each chapter (mini) + Final climax CTA
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Progressive reveal. Each chapter has distinct color. Building intensity.
landingPatterns.effects: ScrollTrigger animations, parallax layers, progressive disclosure, chapter transitions
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Keep the narrative understandable without scroll-driven effects. Use progress indicator. Mobile: simplify animations. Keep DOM reading order complete; disable parallax and scroll-scrub under reduced motion. Pause scroll animation when offscreen or hidden and render each chapter in its final readable state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: AI Personalization Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: ai, personalization, smart, recommendation, dynamic
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Dynamic hero (personalized) > Relevant features > Tailored testimonials > Smart CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Context-aware placement based on user segment
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Adaptive based on user data. A/B test color variations per segment.
landingPatterns.effects: Dynamic content swap, fade transitions, personalized product recommendations
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Validate personalization with consent-aware product analytics. Requires analytics integration. Fallback for new users.

landingPatterns.name: Waitlist/Coming Soon
landingPatterns.keywords: waitlist, coming-soon, launch, early-access, notify, countdown accessibility, pause animation, reduced motion final state, verified waitlist count
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero with countdown > Product teaser/preview > Email capture form > Social proof (waitlist count)
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Email form prominent (above fold) + Sticky form on scroll
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Anticipation: Dark + accent highlights. Countdown in brand color. Urgency indicators.
landingPatterns.effects: Countdown timer animation, email validation feedback, success confetti, social share buttons
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Explain early-access benefits without fabricated scarcity. Show a waitlist count only when it is current, verified, and dated. Provide a static launch deadline, pause decorative countdown motion when offscreen/hidden, and render the final readable timer state under reduced motion. Email form and referral actions remain keyboard operable.

landingPatterns.name: Comparison Table Focus
landingPatterns.keywords: comparison, table, versus, compare, features
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (problem statement) > Comparison matrix (you vs competitors) > Feature deep-dive > Winner CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: After comparison table (highlighted row) + Bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Your product column highlighted (accent bg or green). Competitors neutral. Checkmarks green.
landingPatterns.effects: Table row hover highlight, feature checkmark animations, sticky comparison header
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Show value vs competitors. Measure comparison performance with product-specific analytics. Be factual. Include pricing if favorable.

landingPatterns.name: Pricing-Focused Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: pricing, price, cost, plans, subscription
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (value proposition) > Pricing cards (3 tiers) > Feature comparison > FAQ > Final CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Each pricing card + Sticky CTA in nav + Bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Popular plan highlighted (brand color border/bg). Free: grey. Enterprise: dark/premium.
landingPatterns.effects: Price toggle monthly/annual animation, card hover lift, FAQ accordion smooth open
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Show actual monthly and annual totals and savings transparently. Explain plan differences and address objections in the FAQ.

landingPatterns.name: App Store Style Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: app, mobile, download, store, install, carousel accessibility, keyboard accessible carousel, pause auto rotation, reduced motion final state, single pointer buttons
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero with device mockup > Screenshots carousel > Features with icons > Reviews/ratings > Download CTAs
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Dark/light matching app store feel. Star ratings in gold. Screenshots with device frames.
landingPatterns.effects: Device mockup rotations, screenshot slider, star rating animations, download button pulse
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Show real screenshots and only current verified ratings. Provide platform-specific CTAs, buttons and keyboard controls in addition to swipe, and pause any auto-rotation. Stop auto-rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected screenshot as the static final state.

landingPatterns.name: FAQ/Documentation Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: faq, documentation, help, support, questions, faq/documentation, knowledge base
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero with search bar > Popular categories > FAQ accordion > Contact/support CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Search bar prominent + Contact CTA for unresolved questions
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Clean, high readability. Minimal color. Category icons in brand color. Success green for resolved.
landingPatterns.effects: Search autocomplete, smooth accordion open/close, category hover, helpful feedback buttons
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Reduce support tickets. Track search analytics. Show related articles. Contact escalation path.

landingPatterns.name: Immersive/Interactive Experience
landingPatterns.keywords: immersive, interactive, experience, 3d, animation, immersive/interactive experience
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Full-screen interactive element > Guided product tour > Key benefits revealed > CTA after completion
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: After interaction complete + Skip option for impatient users
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Immersive experience colors. Dark background for focus. Highlight interactive elements.
landingPatterns.effects: WebGL, 3D interactions, gamification elements, progress indicators, reward animations
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Measure engagement for the specific audience and device mix. Performance trade-off. Provide skip option. Mobile fallback essential. Provide skip, keyboard, reduced-motion, and non-3D fallback paths. Pause animation when offscreen/hidden and preserve the completed final state when reduced motion is enabled.

landingPatterns.name: Event/Conference Landing

landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Register CTA sticky + After speakers + Bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Urgency colors (countdown). Event branding. Speaker cards professional. Sponsor logos neutral.
landingPatterns.effects: Countdown timer, speaker hover cards with bio, agenda tabs, early bird countdown
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Early bird pricing with deadline. Social proof (past attendees). Speaker credibility. Multi-ticket discounts. Expose the exact deadline as text; pause decorative countdown motion offscreen/hidden and show a static final state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Product Review/Ratings Focused
landingPatterns.keywords: reviews, ratings, testimonials, social-proof, social-proof-focused, stars
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (product + aggregate rating) > Rating breakdown > Individual reviews > Buy/CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: After reviews summary + Buy button alongside reviews
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Trust colors. Star ratings gold. Verified badge green. Review sentiment colors.
landingPatterns.effects: Star fill animations, review filtering, helpful vote interactions, photo lightbox
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: User-generated content builds trust. Show verified purchases. Filter by rating. Respond to negative reviews.

landingPatterns.name: Community/Forum Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: community, forum, social, members, discussion, verified member count, live update accessibility, pause updates, reduced motion final state
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (community value prop) > Popular topics/categories > Active members showcase > Join CTA

landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Warm, welcoming. Member photos add humanity. Topic badges in brand colors. Activity indicators green.
landingPatterns.effects: Member avatars animation, activity feed live updates, topic hover previews, join success celebration
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Preview real community value and simplify onboarding. Show member and activity counts only when current, verified, and dated; label activity as live only when backed by an active real-time source. Provide pause/update-frequency controls for moving feeds, stop work offscreen/hidden, and keep a static final state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Before-After Transformation
landingPatterns.keywords: before-after, transformation, results, comparison, accessible drag interaction, drag single pointer alternative, keyboard drag alternative
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (problem state) > Transformation slider/comparison > How it works > Results CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: After transformation reveal + Bottom

landingPatterns.effects: Slider comparison interaction, before/after reveal animations, result counters, testimonial videos

Provide arrow buttons and keyboard steps so dragging is not required. Arrow buttons and keyboard steps expose the same final before/after positions; reduced motion removes reveal animation.

landingPatterns.name: Marketplace / Directory

landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Hero Search Bar + Navbar 'List your item'
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Search: High contrast. Categories: Visual icons. Trust: Blue/Green.
landingPatterns.effects: Search autocomplete animation, map hover pins, card carousel
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Search is the primary CTA. Reduce friction with useful suggestions. For featured-listing carousels, provide previous/next and play/pause buttons, full keyboard access, and a single-pointer alternative to swiping; stop rotation on focus, hover, offscreen/hidden, or reduced motion and render the selected listing as the static final state.

landingPatterns.name: Newsletter / Content First

landingPatterns.effects: Text highlight animations, typewriter effect, subtle fade-in

landingPatterns.effects: Countdown timer, speaker avatar float, urgent ticker
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: State the event time and timezone in text. Claim limited seats or live status only when current capacity or stream state is verified and timestamped. Provide pause/hide controls for the urgency ticker, stop it offscreen/hidden, keep controls keyboard operable, and render a static final state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.effects: Hover card scale (1.02), video inside cards, tilt effect, staggered reveal
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Scannable value props. High information density without clutter. Mobile stack. Keep cards usable without hover and suppress tilt/stagger/video motion under reduced motion. Pause card media offscreen/hidden and render cards in their final readable state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Interactive 3D Configurator
landingPatterns.keywords: 3d, configurator, customizer, interactive, product, interactive product demo, accessible drag interaction, drag single pointer alternative, keyboard drag alternative
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (Configurator) > Feature Highlight (synced) > Price/Specs > Purchase
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Inside Configurator UI + Sticky Bottom Bar
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Neutral studio background. Product: Realistic materials. UI: Minimal overlay.
landingPatterns.effects: Real-time rendering, material swap animation, camera rotate/zoom, light reflection
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Let users inspect product details before purchase. Provide buttons and keyboard controls for rotate/zoom plus a 2D/specification fallback. Named rotate/zoom buttons and keyboard controls replace drag gestures; pause rendering offscreen/hidden and preserve the chosen configuration as the reduced-motion final state.

landingPatterns.name: AI-Driven Dynamic Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: ai, dynamic, personalized, adaptive, generative
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Prompt/Input Hero > Generated Result Preview > How it Works > Value Prop
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Input Field (Hero) + 'Try it' Buttons
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Adaptive to user input. Dark mode for compute feel. Neon accents.
landingPatterns.effects: Typing text effects, shimmering generation loaders, morphing layouts
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Immediate value demonstration. 'Show, don't tell'. Low friction start. Disable typing, shimmer, and morphing effects when reduced motion is requested. Pause loaders offscreen/hidden and render generated content in its final state under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Feature-Rich Showcase
landingPatterns.keywords: feature-rich, feature-rich showcase, features, showcase, product showcase
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (value prop) > Feature grid/cards (4-6) > Use cases or benefits > Social proof or logos > CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Hero (sticky) + After features + Bottom
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Brand primary + card bg #FAFAFA. Feature icons accent. CTA contrasting.
landingPatterns.effects: Feature card hover lift, scroll reveal, icon micro-interactions
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Clear feature hierarchy. One key message per card. Strong CTA repetition.

landingPatterns.name: Hero-Centric Design
landingPatterns.keywords: hero-centric, hero-centric design, hero-first, hero above fold
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Full-bleed Hero (headline + visual) > Single value prop strip > Key benefit or proof > Primary CTA
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Hero dominant (center/bottom) + Sticky nav CTA
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Hero: High-impact visual. Minimal text. Verify CTA label text against the button fill at 4.5:1 minimum; use 7:1 only for an explicit AAA normal-text target.
landingPatterns.effects: Hero parallax or video, CTA pulse on scroll, minimal chrome
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: One primary CTA. Let the hero dominate the initial viewport without hiding the next content cue. Use a static hero and non-pulsing CTA when reduced motion is requested; provide video controls. Pause hero media offscreen/hidden and keep the final hero message and CTA static under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Trust & Authority + Conversion
landingPatterns.keywords: trust & authority, trust, authority, conversion, credibility, enterprise, carousel accessibility, keyboard accessible carousel, pause auto rotation, reduced motion final state
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (mission/credibility) > Proof (logos, certs, stats) > Solution overview > Clear CTA path
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Contact Sales / Get Quote (primary) + Nav
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Navy/Grey corporate. Trust blue. Accent for CTA only.
landingPatterns.effects: Logo carousel, stat counters, testimonial strip
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Security badges. Case studies. Transparent pricing. Low-friction form. Provide pause/stop and stop the logo carousel on focus, hover, and reduced motion. Previous/next controls provide the keyboard equivalent; pause offscreen/hidden and render a static logo set under reduced motion.

landingPatterns.name: Real-Time / Operations Landing
landingPatterns.keywords: real-time, real-time monitor, operations, dashboard, telemetry, live data, live ticker accessibility, pause live updates, verified live status, reduced motion final state
landingPatterns.sectionOrder: Hero (product + live preview or status) > Key metrics/indicators > How it works > CTA (Start trial / Contact)
landingPatterns.ctaPlacement: Primary CTA in nav + After metrics
landingPatterns.colorStrategy: Dark or neutral. Status colors (green/amber/red). Data-dense but scannable.
landingPatterns.effects: Live data ticker, status pulse, minimal decoration
landingPatterns.conversionNotes: Offer a demo or sandbox and show trust signals. Label telemetry as live only when backed by a current source, with update time and stale state. Provide pause/hide or update-frequency controls for tickers and previews, stop offscreen/hidden work, support keyboard controls, and render a static final snapshot under reduced motion.

uxRules.description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires a single-pointer alternative for author-controlled drag operations

motion.keywords: hover, button, opacity, lift, press feedback
motion.do: Keep displacement under 2px so it reads as feedback not motion
motion.dont: Don't animate layout-affecting props (width/height/margin) on hover

motion.keywords: hover, card, scale, tilt, cursor feedback
motion.do: Pair with a matching mouseleave tween that reverses the same properties
motion.dont: Don't leave the hover state stuck if the pointer leaves fast; always attach the reverse tween

motion.keywords: hover, magnetic, cursor follow, 3d tilt, removable event listener cleanup
motion.do: Clamp the pull strength (e.g. * 0.3) so the element never fully leaves its hit box
motion.dont: Don't apply magnetic effect to more than 1-2 focal elements per screen; it becomes noisy

motion.keywords: scroll, fade in, reveal, on view
motion.do: Keep the y offset small (8-16px) so it reads as a fade, not a slide
motion.dont: Don't reveal below-the-fold content needed for SEO/crawlers as invisible-by-default without a no-JS fallback

motion.keywords: scroll, slide up, staggered section, reveal
motion.do: Scope the ScrollTrigger to the section container so it doesn't re-scan the whole page
motion.dont: Don't stagger more than ~8 children; beyond that the last items feel laggy

motion.do: Use scrub: true or a small number (0.5-1.5) instead of instant jumps so it feels tied to the scrollbar
motion.dont: Don't pin more than 1-2 sections per page; excessive pinning fights native scroll feel and hurts mobile UX

motion.do: Keep per-item stagger delay small (0.02-0.04s) for lists longer than 10 items
motion.dont: Don't stagger by more than 0.1s per item on long lists; total reveal time becomes sluggish

motion.do: Combine with from: 'center' for a bento-grid layout to draw the eye inward first
motion.dont: Don't use back.out on dense data tables; the overshoot reads as sloppy on informational UI

motion.keywords: stagger, wave, text reveal, split text
motion.do: Revert SplitText on unmount/cleanup (split.revert()) to restore original text nodes for accessibility tools
motion.dont: Don't split-animate long paragraphs; reserve for short headlines (under ~8 words)

motion.do: Preload the destination route's critical assets before the exit tween finishes
motion.dont: Don't block navigation on animation; cap exit duration at ~250ms so the app never feels unresponsive

motion.do: Show a lightweight loading indicator if the destination route's data fetch outlasts the overlay
motion.dont: Don't tie the overlay's reveal directly to data-fetch completion without a max-wait timeout; a slow API stalls the whole transition

motion.do: Verify the shared element exists in both DOM states before calling Flip.from to avoid a silent no-op
motion.dont: Don't use shared-element transitions across more than one element pair per navigation; compounding Flips are hard to time correctly

motion.do: Keep the yPercent delta small (5-15) so foreground and background never desync distractingly
motion.dont: Don't parallax body copy; it hurts reading comfort and can trigger motion sickness

motion.do: Vary speed per layer (background slowest, foreground fastest) to sell the depth illusion
motion.dont: Don't let parallax layers overflow their container; clip with overflow: hidden on the wrapper

motion.keywords: loading, skeleton, shimmer, pulse, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, reduced motion final state
motion.do: Use a CSS gradient background-position sweep rather than opacity pulsing; reads as 'loading' more clearly
motion.dont: Don't run more than one shimmer loop per skeleton group; sync them under one timeline so the wave reads as a single unit

motion.keywords: progress, spinner, morphing loader, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, reduced motion final state
motion.do: Cap total loop duration under ~1.5s so long waits don't feel like the UI froze on a single beat
motion.dont: Don't use elaborate loaders for sub-300ms waits; they flash and feel worse than no indicator

motion.keywords: carousel, auto-rotate, pause, focus, hover, reduced-motion, stop animation offscreen, visibility pause, timer cleanup, final state
motion.do: Provide previous/next and play/pause controls; announce the current slide without moving focus
motion.dont: Don't auto-advance without a visible stop control or continue while focus is inside
